meta.title: GRN Photo / Document Attachment: refused for a user without the Warehouse Executive role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Executive role and as a Warehouse Executive on the same Enterprise tenant, open a GRN, and verify that GRN Photo / Document Attachment is refused or absent for the first user but available for the Warehouse Executive.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Executive role and as a Warehouse Executive on the same Enterprise tenant, open a GRN, and verify that GRN Photo / Document Attachment is refused or absent for the first user but available for the Warehouse Executive.
